```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>7-Day CPU Temperature Chart</title>
    <style>
        body {
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            height: 100vh;
            margin: 0;
            background-color: #f0f0f0;
        }
        .chart-container {
            width: 800px;
            height: 500px;
            background-color: white;
            border-radius: 8px;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
            padding: 20px;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }
        canvas {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }
        .title {
            text-align: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            font-size: 18px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="chart-container">
        <div class="title">7-Day CPU Temperature (°C)</div>
        <canvas id="temperatureChart"></canvas>
    </div>

    <script>
        // Sample data: 7 days of CPU temperatures (40-85°C)
        const days = ['Day 1', 'Day 2', 'Day 3', 'Day 4', 'Day 5', 'Day 6', 'Day 7'];
        const temperatures = [
            55, 60, 45, 70, 80, 65, 75
        ];

        const ctx = document.getElementById('temperatureChart').getContext('2d');
        const chart = new Chart(ctx, {
            type: 'line',
            data: {
                labels: days,
                datasets: [{
                    label: 'CPU Temperature (°C)',
                    data: temperatures,
                    borderColor: 'rgba(255, 99, 132, 1)',
                    backgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 99, 132, 0.2)',
                    borderWidth: 2,
                    pointBackgroundColor: 'rgba(255, 99, 132, 1)',
                    pointRadius: 5,
                    pointHoverRadius: 7,
                    tension: 0.3
                }]
            },
            options: {
                responsive: true,
                scales: {
                    y: {
                        beginAtZero: false,
                        min: 40,
                        max: 85,
                        title: {
                            display: true,
                            text: 'Temperature (°C)'
                        },
                        ticks: {
                            stepSize: 5
                        }
                    },
                    x: {
                        title: {
                            display: true,
                            text: 'Day'
                        }
                    }
                },
                plugins: {
                    legend: {
                        display: true,
                        position: 'top'
                    },
                    tooltip: {
                        callbacks: {
                            label: function(context) {
                                return `${context.dataset.label}: ${context.raw}°C`;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>
```
